string.text: Enable: Grenade only show when pin pulled

Note: 
• Deployed tripwire traps will disappear when you leave the current map. 
• Deployed tripwire traps can be recovered. 
 
Deploy UI: 
 Mouse 1: Deploy. 
 Mouse 2: Cancel. 
 Lean left: Rotate left. 
 Lean right: Rotate right.
\nEnable: Player's tripwire traps will not be triggered by nor do damage to allies and companions. \nDisable: Disable this option.

Note: 
• Deployed IEDs will disappear when you leave the current map. 
• Deployed IEDs can be recovered. 
• Use a cellphone to detonate deployed IEDs. 
 
Deploy UI: 
 Mouse 1: Deploy. 
 Mouse 2: Cancel. 
 
Usage: 
 Deploy IEDs. 
 Open PDA, right click on the IED icons, choose Select or Deselect. 
 While PDA is opened, press [Detonate selected IEDs] to make selected IEDs explode.

Note: 
• Deployed drones will disappear when you leave the current map. 
• Hostile stalkers will shoot drones when flying close. 
• Mutants will be alert when drones flying close. 
• When drones being shotdown, attached explosive will not detonate and will disappear. 
 
Deploy: 
 Mouse 1: Deploy. 
 Mouse 2: Cancel. 
 
Movement: 
 Key [Sprint] -> Ascent. 
 Key [Crouch] -> Descent. 
 Key [Forward] -> Forward. 
 Key [Backward] -> Backward. 
 Key [Strafe left] -> Strafe left. 
 Key [Strafe right] -> Strafe right. 
 Key [Lean left] -> Steer left. 
 Key [Lean right] -> Steer right. 
 
Action: 
 Key [Use] -> Stop controlling drone. 
 Mouse wheel -> Camera zoom.
